```{r}
habitat_data   <- read.csv("7.18_CoverClassPercent_clean.csv")
call_data      <- read.csv("long_all_call_data_2021_2024.csv")
dip_data       <- read.csv("dipnet_data_2019_2024_JAS.csv")
hydro_data     <- read.csv("WetlandHydroperiod_2024_EK.csv")
wet_near_data  <- read.csv("wetlands_nearby_clean.csv")
ratio_data     <- read.csv("ratio_b_tof_1.csv")  # must contain Site, WetlandID, ratio_1_f_to_b
egg_data       <- readr::read_csv("egg_mass_clean_capito.csv")
```

```{r}
# --- Robust dates + safe Month/Year/YearIndex ---
# (requires lubridate)
library(lubridate)

# Parse CALL dates flexibly (mdy/ymd/dmy)
if (!inherits(call_data$Date1, "Date")) {
  d1 <- suppressWarnings(ymd(call_data$Date1))
  miss <- is.na(d1)
  if (any(miss)) d1[miss] <- suppressWarnings(mdy(call_data$Date1[miss]))
  miss <- is.na(d1)
  if (any(miss)) d1[miss] <- suppressWarnings(dmy(call_data$Date1[miss]))
  call_data$Date1 <- as.Date(d1)
}

# Parse DIP dates (supports Excel serials or mixed strings)
if (is.numeric(dip_data$Date)) {
  dip_data$Date <- as.Date(dip_data$Date, origin = "1899-12-30")
} else if (!inherits(dip_data$Date, "Date")) {
  dd <- suppressWarnings(ymd(dip_data$Date))
  miss <- is.na(dd)
  if (any(miss)) dd[miss] <- suppressWarnings(mdy(dip_data$Date[miss]))
  miss <- is.na(dd)
  if (any(miss)) dd[miss] <- suppressWarnings(dmy(dip_data$Date[miss]))
  dip_data$Date <- as.Date(dd)
}

# Harmonize site names
fix_sites <- function(x) dplyr::recode(x,
  "Ceylon" = "Ceylon WMA",
  "Jones Center" = "Jones Center Ichauway",
  "ARWMA" = "Alapaha River WMA",
  "TWMA" = "Townsend WMA"
)

call_data$Site     <- fix_sites(call_data$Site)
dip_data$Site      <- fix_sites(dip_data$Site)
habitat_data$Site  <- fix_sites(habitat_data$Site)
hydro_data$Site    <- fix_sites(hydro_data$Site)
wet_near_data$Site <- fix_sites(wet_near_data$Site)
ratio_data$Site    <- fix_sites(ratio_data$Site)

# Keep only Ceylon WMA & Jones Center Ichauway in all tables
keep_sites <- c("Ceylon WMA", "Jones Center Ichauway")
call_data     <- call_data    %>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)
dip_data      <- dip_data     %>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)
habitat_data  <- habitat_data %>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)
hydro_data    <- hydro_data   %>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)
wet_near_data <- wet_near_data%>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)
ratio_data    <- ratio_data   %>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)

# Standardize column name to match the rest of the pipeline
if ("wetland_id" %in% names(ratio_data) && !("WetlandID" %in% names(ratio_data))) {
  ratio_data <- ratio_data %>% rename(WetlandID = wetland_id)
}

# Subset to study wetlands only (Site+WetlandID present in hydro)
key_h <- hydro_data %>% distinct(Site, WetlandID)
call_data    <- call_data    %>% semi_join(key_h, by=c("Site","WetlandID"))
dip_data     <- dip_data     %>% semi_join(key_h, by=c("Site","WetlandID"))
habitat_data <- habitat_data %>% semi_join(key_h, by=c("Site","WetlandID"))
wet_near_data<- wet_near_data%>% semi_join(key_h, by=c("Site","WetlandID"))
ratio_data   <- ratio_data   %>% semi_join(key_h, by=c("Site","WetlandID"))

# Species recode (only need LICAP)
call_data$Species <- dplyr::recode(call_data$Species, "LICAP" = "Rana capito")
dip_data$Species  <- dplyr::recode(dip_data$Species,  "LICAP" = "Rana capito")

# Keep only Rana capito for detections
call_data <- call_data %>% filter(Species == "Rana capito")
dip_data  <- dip_data  %>% filter(Species == "Rana capito")

# Fix call score (treat NA as 0; also cap 4 -> 3 if present)
call_data$Call_Score[is.na(call_data$Call_Score)] <- 0
call_data$Call_Score[call_data$Call_Score == 4] <- 3
call_data$Detected <- as.integer(call_data$Call_Score > 0)

# Month & Year (robust)
call_data$Month <- factor(month(call_data$Date1, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
                          levels = month.name)
dip_data$Month  <- factor(month(dip_data$Date,  label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
                          levels = month.name)

if (!"Year" %in% names(call_data) || all(is.na(call_data$Year))) {
  call_data$Year <- year(call_data$Date1)
}
if (!"Year" %in% names(dip_data)  || all(is.na(dip_data$Year))) {
  dip_data$Year <- year(dip_data$Date)
}

# Years (union) + indices
all_years <- sort(unique(c(call_data$Year, dip_data$Year)))
call_data$YearIndex <- match(call_data$Year, all_years)
dip_data$YearIndex  <- match(dip_data$Year , all_years)

nYear   <- length(all_years)
nMonths <- 12


```

```{r}
site_levels <- factor(keep_sites, levels = keep_sites) # ensure order: Ceylon, Jones
nSites <- length(site_levels)

# Count wetlands per site (from hydro)
nWetlands_tbl <- hydro_data %>%
  group_by(Site) %>% summarise(nWet = n_distinct(WetlandID), .groups="drop") %>%
  complete(Site = site_levels, fill = list(nWet = 0)) %>%
  arrange(Site)

nWetlands_vec <- nWetlands_tbl$nWet
maxWetlands   <- max(nWetlands_vec)

# Make a lookup index for wetlands per site
wet_index <- hydro_data %>%
  arrange(Site, WetlandID) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  mutate(WetID = as.integer(factor(WetlandID, levels = unique(WetlandID)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(Site, WetlandID, WetID) %>% distinct()

```

```{r}
# Canopy cover (% of tree veg)
can_pre <- habitat_data %>%
  filter(VegType == "tree") %>%
  select(Site, WetlandID, CovPercent) %>%
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID"))

canopy <- matrix(NA_real_, nSites, maxWetlands)
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  ss <- can_pre %>% filter(Site == site_levels[j])
  if (nrow(ss)) canopy[j, ss$WetID] <- ss$CovPercent
}

# Hydroperiod (0–12 proportion of months with water)
hyd_pre <- hydro_data %>%
  select(Site, WetlandID, prop_water) %>%
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID"))

hydro <- matrix(NA_real_, nSites, maxWetlands)
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  ss <- hyd_pre %>% filter(Site == site_levels[j])
  if (nrow(ss)) hydro[j, ss$WetID] <- as.numeric(ss$prop_water)
}

# Nearby wetlands (within 500 m)
near_pre <- wet_near_data %>%
  select(Site, WetlandID, Count_500) %>%
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID"))

nNearby_05 <- matrix(NA_real_, nSites, maxWetlands)
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  ss <- near_pre %>% filter(Site == site_levels[j])
  if (nrow(ss)) nNearby_05[j, ss$WetID] <- ss$Count_500
}

# ----- Ratio covariate (observed only at Ceylon) -----
# Make sure the column names match your CSV (adjust 'ratio_b_to_f_1' if needed)
ratio_pre <- ratio_data %>%
  select(Site, WetlandID, ratio_b_to_f_1) %>%    # <- check this name in your CSV
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID"))

# Fill matrix with NA where unavailable
ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nSites, maxWetlands)
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  ss <- ratio_pre %>% filter(Site == site_levels[j])
  if (nrow(ss)) ratio_mat[j, ss$WetID] <- as.numeric(ss$ratio_b_to_f_1)
}

# Indicator of availability (1 = observed at this site/wetland, 0 = missing)
ratio_obs <- ifelse(is.na(ratio_mat), 0L, 1L)

# Build ratio_mat exactly as you do now...
# Compute mean/sd from observed (i.e., non-NA) entries (these will all be Ceylon)
ratio_vec_obs <- as.numeric(ratio_mat[!is.na(ratio_mat)])
ratio_mean <- mean(ratio_vec_obs)       # Ceylon-only
ratio_sd   <- sd(ratio_vec_obs); if (is.na(ratio_sd) || ratio_sd == 0) ratio_sd <- 1
ratio_sc <- (ratio_mat - ratio_mean) / ratio_sd
ratio_sc0 <- ratio_sc; ratio_sc0[is.na(ratio_sc0)] <- 0


# Safe scaling helper
safe_scale_mat <- function(M) {
  apply(M, 2, function(x) {
    s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE); m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(s) || s == 0) ifelse(is.na(x), NA, 0) else (x - m)/s
  })
}

canopy_sc    <- safe_scale_mat(canopy)
hydro_sc     <- safe_scale_mat(hydro)
nNearby_sc   <- safe_scale_mat(nNearby_05)


```

```{r}
## ================================
## Arrays (site × wetland × month × year)
## ================================
effort_dip  <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))
effort_call <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))
effort_egg  <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))

y_dip   <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))
y_call  <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))
y_egg   <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))

## ================================
## DIP: effort & detections (collapsed to one cell per month)
## ================================
# Required: dip_data$Detected is 0/1
stopifnot("Detected" %in% names(dip_data))

dip_use <- dip_data %>%
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID")) %>%
  mutate(
    site_j = as.integer(factor(Site, levels = site_levels)),
    mon_k  = as.integer(Month),           # Month already factor(month.name)
    yr_t   = YearIndex,                   # 1..nYear
    det    = as.integer(Detected > 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(site_j), !is.na(WetID), !is.na(mon_k), mon_k >= 1, mon_k <= 12,
         !is.na(yr_t), yr_t >= 1, yr_t <= nYear) %>%
  group_by(site_j, WetID, mon_k, yr_t) %>%
  summarise(
    effort = 1L,                          # any visit that month = effort
    y      = as.integer(any(det == 1L)),  # detection if any visit detected
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (nrow(dip_use)) {
  idx <- as.matrix(dip_use[, c("site_j","WetID","mon_k","yr_t")])
  effort_dip[idx] <- 1L
  y_dip[idx]      <- dip_use$y
}

cat("DIP  | effort cells:", sum(effort_dip), " detections:", sum(y_dip), "\n")
stopifnot(all(y_dip <= effort_dip))

## ================================
## CALL: effort & detections (analyzed files only; collapsed to month)
## ================================
# Required: call_data$Detected is 0/1 (you created from Call_Score)
stopifnot("Detected" %in% names(call_data))

call_use <- call_data %>%
  filter(!(is.na(Listener) | Listener == "")) %>%     # only analyzed files
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID")) %>%
  mutate(
    site_j = as.integer(factor(Site, levels = site_levels)),
    mon_k  = as.integer(Month),
    yr_t   = YearIndex,
    det    = as.integer(Detected > 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(site_j), !is.na(WetID), !is.na(mon_k), mon_k >= 1, mon_k <= 12,
         !is.na(yr_t), yr_t >= 1, yr_t <= nYear) %>%
  group_by(site_j, WetID, mon_k, yr_t) %>%
  summarise(
    effort = 1L,                          # any analyzed file that month
    y      = as.integer(any(det == 1L)),  # detection if any analyzed file detected
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (nrow(call_use)) {
  idx <- as.matrix(call_use[, c("site_j","WetID","mon_k","yr_t")])
  effort_call[idx] <- 1L
  y_call[idx]      <- call_use$y
}

cat("CALL | effort cells:", sum(effort_call), " detections:", sum(y_call), "\n")
stopifnot(all(y_call <= effort_call))

## ================================
## EGG: effort & detections (collapsed to month)
## ================================
# Required: egg_data$Detected is 0/1
stopifnot("Detected" %in% names(egg_data))

egg_data_clean <- egg_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(wetlandid), wetlandid != 10) %>%   # drop NA and wetland 10
  mutate(
    wetlandid = as.character(wetlandid),           # cast to character
    wetlandid = stringr::str_replace(wetlandid, "\\.0+$", ""),  # strip trailing .0
    wetlandid = stringr::str_trim(wetlandid)
  )

egg_use <- egg_data_clean %>%
  rename(Site = site, WetlandID = wetlandid, Year = year) %>%
  mutate(Month = factor(month, levels = month.name),
         Year  = as.integer(Year)) %>%
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID")) %>%
  mutate(
    site_j = as.integer(factor(Site, levels = site_levels)),
    mon_k  = as.integer(Month),
    yr_t   = match(Year, all_years),      # convert Year -> 1..nYear
    det    = as.integer(Detected > 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(site_j), !is.na(WetID), !is.na(mon_k), mon_k >= 1, mon_k <= 12,
         !is.na(yr_t), yr_t >= 1, yr_t <= nYear) %>%
  group_by(site_j, WetID, mon_k, yr_t) %>%
  summarise(
    effort = 1L,                          # any egg visit that month
    y      = as.integer(any(det == 1L)),  # detection if any egg visit detected
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (nrow(egg_use)) {
  idx <- as.matrix(egg_use[, c("site_j","WetID","mon_k","yr_t")])
  effort_egg[idx] <- 1L
  y_egg[idx]      <- egg_use$y
}

cat("EGG  | effort cells:", sum(effort_egg), " detections:", sum(y_egg), "\n")
stopifnot(all(y_egg <= effort_egg))

## ================================
## Global sanity
## ================================
stopifnot(all(y_dip  <= effort_dip),
          all(y_call <= effort_call),
          all(y_egg  <= effort_egg))

```


```{r}
# Landscape index (1=Ceylon, 2=Jones) for random effect
landscape <- c(1, 2)  # length = nSites
nLand <- 2

# Replace remaining NAs in covariates with 0 (post-scaling)
cov_na_to0 <- function(M) { M[is.na(M)] <- 0; M }
canopy_sc  <- cov_na_to0(canopy_sc)
hydro_sc   <- cov_na_to0(hydro_sc)
nNearby_sc <- cov_na_to0(nNearby_sc)


data_list <- list(
  nSites = nSites,
  nLand  = nLand,
  nMonths = nMonths,
  nYear  = nYear,
  nWetlands = nWetlands_vec,
  maxWetlands = maxWetlands,
  landscape = landscape,
  canopy = canopy_sc,
  hydro  = hydro_sc,
  dist   = nNearby_sc,
  ratio  = ratio_sc0,     # scaled, with NAs replaced by 0
  ratio_obs = ratio_obs,  # 0/1 mask of availability
  y_dip = y_dip,
  y_call = y_call,
  y_egg  = y_egg,
  effort_dip  = effort_dip,
  effort_call = effort_call,
  effort_egg  = effort_egg
)


```

```{r}
cat(file = "licap_occ_simple.jags", '
model{

  # Priors
  alpha0        ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  alpha_canopy  ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  alpha_hydro   ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  alpha_dist    ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  alpha_ratio   ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)

  tau_land ~ dgamma(0.1, 0.1)
  for(l in 1:nLand){
    land_re[l] ~ dnorm(0, tau_land)
  }

  beta0_dip  ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  beta0_call ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  beta0_egg  ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)   # NEW

  pr_dip  ~ dexp(1)
  pr_call ~ dexp(1)
  pr_egg  ~ dexp(1)            # NEW

  for(m in 1:nMonths){
    beta_mon_dip[m]  ~ dnorm(0, pr_dip)
    beta_mon_call[m] ~ dnorm(0, pr_call)
    beta_mon_egg[m]  ~ dnorm(0, pr_egg)  # NEW
  }
  for(t in 1:nYear){
    beta_yr_dip[t]   ~ dnorm(0, pr_dip)
    beta_yr_call[t]  ~ dnorm(0, pr_call)
    beta_yr_egg[t]   ~ dnorm(0, pr_egg)  # NEW
  }

  # Ecological & observation processes (single species)
  for(j in 1:nSites){
    for(w in 1:nWetlands[j]){
      for(t in 1:nYear){

logit(psi[j,w,t]) <- alpha0
                    + land_re[landscape[j]]
                    + alpha_canopy * canopy[j,w]
                    + alpha_hydro  * hydro[j,w]
                    + alpha_dist   * dist[j,w]
                    + alpha_ratio  * ratio[j,w] * ratio_obs[j,w]

        z[j,w,t] ~ dbern(psi[j,w,t])

        for(m in 1:nMonths){
          logit(p_dip[j,w,m,t])  <- beta0_dip  + beta_mon_dip[m]  + beta_yr_dip[t]
          logit(p_call[j,w,m,t]) <- beta0_call + beta_mon_call[m] + beta_yr_call[t]
          logit(p_egg[j,w,m,t])  <- beta0_egg  + beta_mon_egg[m]  + beta_yr_egg[t]  # NEW

          y_dip[j,w,m,t]  ~ dbern(z[j,w,t] * p_dip[j,w,m,t]  * effort_dip[j,w,m,t])
          y_call[j,w,m,t] ~ dbern(z[j,w,t] * p_call[j,w,m,t] * effort_call[j,w,m,t])
          y_egg[j,w,m,t]  ~ dbern(z[j,w,t] * p_egg[j,w,m,t]  * effort_egg[j,w,m,t])  # NEW
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # Derived: site-year occupancy proportion
  for(j in 1:nSites){
    for(t in 1:nYear){
      occ_count[j,t] <- sum(z[j,1:nWetlands[j],t])
      occ_prop[j,t]  <- occ_count[j,t] / nWetlands[j]
    }
  }
}
')

```

```{r}
# z inits from detections (now include egg too)
z_init <- array(NA, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nYear))
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  for (w in seq_len(nWetlands_vec[j])) {
    for (t in seq_len(nYear)) {
      any_det <- any(y_dip[j,w,,t] == 1) || any(y_call[j,w,,t] == 1) || any(y_egg[j,w,,t] == 1)  # NEW
      z_init[j,w,t] <- ifelse(any_det, 1L, rbinom(1,1,0.5))
    }
  }
}

inits_fun <- function(){
  list(
    z = z_init,
    alpha0 = 0,
    alpha_canopy = 0,
    alpha_hydro  = 0,
    alpha_dist   = 0,
    alpha_ratio  = 0,
    beta0_dip = 0, beta0_call = 0, beta0_egg = 0  # NEW
  )
}

params <- c(
  "alpha0","alpha_canopy","alpha_hydro","alpha_dist","alpha_ratio",
  "land_re",
  "beta0_dip","beta0_call","beta0_egg",                 # NEW
  "beta_mon_dip","beta_mon_call","beta_mon_egg",        # NEW
  "beta_yr_dip","beta_yr_call","beta_yr_egg",           # NEW
  "occ_prop","psi","z"
)

fit <- jagsUI::jags(
  data = data_list,
  inits = inits_fun,
  parameters.to.save = params,
  model.file = "licap_occ_simple.jags",
  n.chains = 3, n.iter = 20000, n.burnin = 10000, n.thin = 4, parallel = TRUE
)

print(fit, digits = 3)


```

```{r}
sumtab <- fit$summary
bad_rhat <- rownames(sumtab)[sumtab[, "Rhat"] > 1.01]
low_neff <- rownames(sumtab)[sumtab[, "n.eff"] < 400]

list(
  rhat_gt_1.01 = bad_rhat,
  neff_lt_400  = low_neff
)
```

```{r}
# ---- Extract posterior means and save ----

# psi is [site, wetland, year] in the model; sims.list adds MCMC-iters as dim 1
stopifnot(!is.null(fit$sims.list$psi), !is.null(fit$sims.list$z))

# Posterior mean occupancy probability from psi
psi_post <- apply(fit$sims.list$psi, c(2, 3, 4), mean)  # dims: [nSites, maxWetlands, nYear]

# Posterior mean of latent z (≈ occupancy probability via the latent state)
z_post <- apply(fit$sims.list$z,   c(2, 3, 4), mean)    # dims: [nSites, maxWetlands, nYear]

# (Optional) nice dimnames for readability
dimnames(psi_post) <- list(
  Site = as.character(site_levels),
  WetID = paste0("W", seq_len(maxWetlands)),
  Year = as.character(all_years)
)
dimnames(z_post) <- dimnames(psi_post)

# Also useful: site-year occupancy proportion (you already monitor occ_prop[j,t])
occ_prop_post <- apply(fit$sims.list$occ_prop, c(2, 3), mean)  # [nSites, nYear]
dimnames(occ_prop_post) <- list(Site = as.character(site_levels),
                                Year = as.character(all_years))

# Save
saveRDS(psi_post, file = "psi_post_mean.rds")
saveRDS(z_post,   file = "z_post_mean.rds")
saveRDS(occ_prop_post, file = "occ_prop_post_mean.rds")

# (Optional) tidy data frames you can View / export
# Map WetID -> WetlandID for each Site
wet_key <- wet_index %>% dplyr::select(Site, WetID, WetlandID)

psi_df <- as.data.frame.table(psi_post, responseName = "psi_mean") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(WetID = as.integer(sub("^W", "", WetID))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(wet_key, by = c("Site", "WetID")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Site, WetlandID, Year, psi_mean)

z_df <- as.data.frame.table(z_post, responseName = "z_mean") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(WetID = as.integer(sub("^W", "", WetID))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(wet_key, by = c("Site", "WetID")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Site, WetlandID, Year, z_mean)

# Quick peek (comment out in knit if noisy)
# print(head(psi_df, 20)); print(head(z_df, 20))



saveRDS(psi_post, file = "psi_post_mean.rds")
saveRDS(z_post,   file = "z_post_mean.rds")

# (Optional) also save helper objects needed by the spatial RMD
saveRDS(wet_index,       file = "wet_index.rds")
saveRDS(nWetlands_vec,   file = "nWetlands_vec.rds")
```

```{r}
# Plot libs
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# Posterior draws (short handles)
s <- fit$sims.list

# Site index helper
site_index <- function(sitename) match(sitename, as.character(site_levels))

# Global raw means/sds (for pretty x-axes; model used per-column scaling for some)
mean_canopy <- mean(canopy, na.rm = TRUE); sd_canopy <- sd(canopy, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_hydro  <- mean(hydro,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_hydro  <- sd(hydro,  na.rm = TRUE)
mean_dist   <- mean(nNearby_05, na.rm = TRUE); sd_dist <- sd(nNearby_05, na.rm = TRUE)

# Ranges to use for raw x-axis labels
rng_canopy <- range(canopy, na.rm = TRUE)
rng_hydro  <- range(hydro,  na.rm = TRUE)         # if prop in [0,1], will reflect that
rng_dist   <- range(nNearby_05, na.rm = TRUE)

# Core linear predictor builder (other covariates held at 0 on the standardized scale)
# For 'ratio', supply ratio_obs = 1 for Ceylon (site 1), 0 for Jones (site 2).
lp_from_cov <- function(z_cov, cov_name = c("hydro","canopy","dist","ratio"), site_j = 1) {
  cov_name <- match.arg(cov_name)
  a0   <- s$alpha0
  aC   <- s$alpha_canopy
  aH   <- s$alpha_hydro
  aD   <- s$alpha_dist
  aR   <- s$alpha_ratio
  re   <- s$land_re[, site_j]

  # z_* values (standardized scale): vary the one of interest, others fixed at 0
  zC <- 0; zH <- 0; zD <- 0; zR <- 0
  if (cov_name == "canopy") zC <- z_cov
  if (cov_name == "hydro")  zH <- z_cov
  if (cov_name == "dist")   zD <- z_cov
  if (cov_name == "ratio")  zR <- z_cov

  # ratio availability multiplier (1 at Ceylon, 0 at Jones)
  rObs <- ifelse(site_j == 1, 1, 0)

  a0 + re + aC*zC + aH*zH + aD*zD + aR*(zR*rObs)
}

# Build effect dataframe: returns median & 80/95% bands for psi vs covariate
effect_df <- function(cov_name, site_name, z_seq = seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 200)) {
  sj <- site_index(site_name)
  stopifnot(!is.na(sj))

  # Predict on standardized scale
  lp_mat <- vapply(z_seq, function(z) lp_from_cov(z, cov_name = cov_name, site_j = sj), numeric(length(s$alpha0)))
  psi_mat <- plogis(lp_mat)

  qs <- t(apply(psi_mat, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.10, 0.20, 0.5, 0.80, 0.90, 0.975)))
  out <- as.data.frame(qs)
  names(out) <- c("lo95","lo90","lo80","med","hi80","hi90","hi95")
  out$z <- z_seq
  out$Site <- site_name
  out$cov <- cov_name

  # Add a "raw" x for labeling (approximate using global mean/sd)
  out$x_raw <- dplyr::case_when(
    cov_name == "hydro"  ~ out$z * sd_hydro  + mean_hydro,
    cov_name == "canopy" ~ out$z * sd_canopy + mean_canopy,
    cov_name == "dist"   ~ out$z * sd_dist   + mean_dist,
    cov_name == "ratio"  ~ out$z * ratio_sd  + ratio_mean
  )
  out
}

```

```{r}
z_prob_yr <- apply(z_draws_yr, c(2, 3), mean, na.rm = TRUE)  # [site, wet]

  dplyr::mutate(WetID = as.integer(sub("^W", "", WetID))) |>

  dplyr::filter(!is.na(WetlandID)) |>

  d |>
    dplyr::arrange(WetlandID_num) |>
    dplyr::mutate(WetlandID_f = factor(WetlandID, levels = unique(WetlandID)))
```

```{r}
# ---- Month effect on detection (no year offset) ----
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

s <- fit$sims.list
stopifnot(!is.null(s$beta0_call), !is.null(s$beta_mon_call),
          !is.null(s$beta0_dip),  !is.null(s$beta_mon_dip))

summ_month_no_year <- function(beta0, beta_mon, method_label = "call") {
  stopifnot(ncol(beta_mon) == 12)
  # p[iter, month] with no year offset
  p_mat <- sapply(1:12, function(m) plogis(beta0 + beta_mon[, m]))

  qs <- apply(p_mat, 2, function(x) quantile(x, probs = c(0.025, 0.10, 0.20, 0.5, 0.80, 0.90, 0.975)))
  df <- as.data.frame(t(qs))
  names(df) <- c("lo95", "lo90", "lo80", "med", "hi80", "hi90", "hi95")
  df$Month <- factor(month.name, levels = month.name)
  df$Method <- method_label
  df
}

df_call <- summ_month_no_year(s$beta0_call, s$beta_mon_call, "Call")
df_dip  <- summ_month_no_year(s$beta0_dip,  s$beta_mon_dip,  "Dip")
df_egg  <- if (!is.null(s$beta0_egg) && !is.null(s$beta_mon_egg)) {
  summ_month_no_year(s$beta0_egg, s$beta_mon_egg, "Egg")
} else NULL

df_month <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_call, df_dip, df_egg)

gg_month_det_noyr <- ggplot(df_month, aes(x = Month, y = med, color = Method, fill = Method, group = Method)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), alpha = 0.08, colour = NA) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo80, ymax = hi80), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Detection probability (p)",
       title = "Month effect on detection probability by method (no year offset)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(gg_month_det_noyr)
# ggsave("month_effect_detection_no_year.png", gg_month_det_noyr, width = 8, height = 4.8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# ---- Landscape random-effect posterior (current model: land_re[l]) ----
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggridges)   # for ridges
library(viridis)    # for viridis_c scale

# Labels for your two landscapes (order must match 'landscape' vector used in the model)
landscape.labels <- c("Ceylon WMA", "Jones Center Ichauway")

# Extract per-iteration draws of land_re (matrix iters x nLand)
stopifnot(!is.null(fit$sims.list$land_re))
land_mat <- as.data.frame(fit$sims.list$land_re)

# Make sure columns are numbered 1..nLand, then pivot long
colnames(land_mat) <- as.character(seq_len(ncol(land_mat)))
land_long <- land_mat |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
               names_to = "Landscape_ID",
               values_to = "Estimate") |>
  mutate(Landscape_ID = as.integer(Landscape_ID),
         Landscape = factor(landscape.labels[Landscape_ID], levels = landscape.labels))

# Sensible x-limits from the draws (instead of hard-coding -70..70)
xlims <- quantile(land_long$Estimate, probs = c(0.005, 0.995), na.rm = TRUE)

# Ridge plot
p_land <- ggplot(land_long, aes(x = Estimate, y = Landscape, fill = stat(x))) +
  geom_density_ridges_gradient(scale = 1.6, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Effect", option = "C") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = xlims) +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior of landscape random effects (occupancy logit scale)",
    x = "land_re (deviation from global intercept)",
    y = "Landscape"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

print(p_land)
# ggsave("ridgeplot_landscape_re.jpeg", p_land, width = 7.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

# (Optional) summarize difference between landscapes
delta <- land_mat[["1"]] - land_mat[["2"]]
cat("Pr(land_re[Ceylon] > land_re[Jones]) = ",
    round(mean(delta > 0), 3), "\n",
    "Median difference (Ceylon - Jones) = ",
    round(median(delta), 3), "\n", sep = "")


```
